svg.title: Read the inputs for one product
svg.desc: The query uses the selected store and SKU with the automatic run and cutoff, filters to one product and returns one row. It contains operational stock, expiry, prices and costs; base demand and elasticity; and scenario multipliers and weights. It does not change prices.

text.tspan: Step 3 · Keep the selected store and SKU; inspect the values used by the next query.
